case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

You wrote that your family foundry takes pride in supplying us with castings from our region and values our long relationship. We feel the same, and we have not forgotten that you held the old price for us in a hard year.

Because of that, we want a fair solution for both family companies. On your cost drivers, labour and steel, we would rather talk about the price we actually pay than about a general increase.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On our recent orders:
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 132.33; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 133.08; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 134.57; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 90 days net.

Option A is the package we can approve. It recognises the pressure on your costs with a higher price, and it keeps the payment term short, so your cash comes in sooner than with the other two options.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We would be glad to settle this directly, owner to owner, as partners who have done right by each other for many years.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

It is always a pleasure to work with your valued house. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point.

Therefore, I am willing to adjust the effective date to 2027-01-01 and accept your proposed 45 days payment term. Our current offer stands at a price of €138.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: a price of €135.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. 

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your fair words on the notice period; we take them in the spirit of the long relationship between our two family companies. We have not forgotten that you held the old price for us in a hard year, and we want a solution that is fair for both of us.

Our line on price stays firm, but we are open on the other terms. Option A is the package we can approve: it brings your price and payment terms together in a way that respects what you have done for us and keeps the business sound for both houses.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 132.33; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 132.37; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 133.08; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

It would help us to understand the labour and steel side of your costing, so that we can speak about the price we actually pay.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Please understand that as a matter of policy we do not provide internal cost breakdowns, though our calculation strictly reflects the necessary adjustments for labor and materials. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
